name: Laikou Japan Sakura Face Sunscreen SPF50 PA+++ 50gm Watery, Moisture, Whitening | Made in P.R.C
description:
Laikou Japan Sakura Face Sunscreen SPF50 PA+++ – 50g

🌸 Brightening | UV Protection | Moisturizing

Product Type: Sunscreen
Volume: 50g
SPF/PA: SPF50 PA+++ (Broad Spectrum UV Protection)
Origin: Product of Japan – Made in China

Key Ingredients & Benefits:

Prunus Lannesiana (Sakura) Flower Extract: Brightens and rejuvenates skin, giving a healthy glow.

Sodium Hyaluronate: Provides deep hydration, keeping skin soft and supple.

Hydrolyzed Rice Protein: Strengthens skin barrier & helps maintain moisture.

Calendula Officinalis Extract: Soothes sensitive skin and reduces irritation.

Centella Asiatica Extract: Promotes skin repair, reduces redness, and calms inflammation.

Features:

SPF50 PA+++ Protection: Shields skin against harmful UVA & UVB rays.

Moisturizing Formula: Prevents dryness & nourishes skin.

Lightweight & Non-Greasy: Absorbs quickly without leaving white cast.

Daily Use: Suitable for face application before makeup or outdoor activities.

Gentle & Safe: Suitable for most skin types.

✅ Best For: Sun protection, hydration, brightening, soothing
✅ Skin Type: All skin types (including sensitive)
✅ Gender: Unisex (Men & Women)
